_notes: M15 spec v2 (2026-04-23): full schema alignment to production
M15$TopDollarSelector$0$ rawdata. Symbol names lowercase, pay_ids
match production exactly, new scatter_trigger kind for pay_id 666.
Core machine — IGT Top Dollar 3×3 single-payline with Feature Play:
- Single wild (doublediamond, multiplier 2) — substitutes for all
regular symbols. 3 wilds on payline → pay_id 1 pure_wild 200×.
- topdollar lands on reel 3 payline only → emits pay_id 666
(WinCredits=0 marker pay, line_id=-1 scatter) and triggers Feature Play.
- jackpot exists on all reels as decorative filler. Paytable §3:
3-jackpot on payline would pay 1000× but game mechanic prevents
this in modes 1/2/5/7 (backend re-rolls); here jackpot is just a
filler that dilutes paying-symbol marginals. Low weight minimizes
RTP impact.
- No mixed-Seven combo (M1 pay_id 10 Seven1+Seven2 has no M15
analog). high7 family splits pay_id 2 (wild-boosted) vs pay_id 21
(pure 3 high7), unique to M15 production schema.
Production pay_id map (from M15$TopDollarSelector$0$ rawdata):
pay_id 1   — 3 doublediamond pure wild, 200×
pay_id 2   — 3 high7 with wild substitutes (wild_required=true), 30×
pay_id 3   — 3 3bar, 20× (wild-boosted via normal substitution)
pay_id 4   — 3 cherry, 15× (cherry_count=3)
pay_id 5   — 3 2bar, 10×
pay_id 7   — 3 1bar, 5×
pay_id 8   — mixed 3 bars (1bar/2bar/3bar combo), 2×
pay_id 9   — 1 cherry anywhere, 1× (cherry_count=1)
pay_id 21  — 3 high7 pure (wild_required=false), 30×
pay_id 71  — 2 cherry anywhere, 5× (cherry_count=2)
pay_id 666 — topdollar scatter trigger on reel 3 payline, WinCredits=0
Symbol rename (pre-v2 → v2):
Blank → blank, Cherry → cherry, Bar1 (=20×) → 3bar,
Bar2 (=10×) → 2bar, Bar3 (=5×) → 1bar, High7 → high7,
Wild → doublediamond, Bonus → topdollar. Added jackpot (filler).
Feature Play (shipped v5+, retuned v7 2026-04-24):
- Triggered when topdollar lands reel 3 payline (pay_id 666 emits)
- Feature EV math lives in slot_designer/engine/feature_m15.py
- Rawdata emits ST=1 (trigger) + ST=14 (each offer round) + ST=15
(end marker w/ WinAmount); runtime in engine/spin.spin_session
- Per round: roll count_x ∈ [1,5] + count_y ∈ [0,2] by weights,
then weighted-draw WITHOUT replacement x_value_weights and
y_value_weights. R = sum(x) × product(y).
- 3 reroll + 1 forced accept = 4 rounds max; simulated player
accepts when R ≥ accept_threshold (40 across all modes).
- Per-mode feature_params override (see weights/M15/mode_<N>/
weights.json feature_params block + weights/M15/MODE_DESIGN.md).

pays._note: Emits win=0 marker pay when topdollar lands on reel 3 middle row (payline). Signals Feature Play trigger for downstream analyzer. Coexists with main payline pay in PayoutIdToWinAmount.

features.name: FeaturePlay
features._status: EV analysis shipped (slot_designer.machines.M15.plugins.feature with per-card weighted sampling, v5 2026-04-23); spin-time engine integration deferred to Phase 2. pay_id 666 marker now emits via scatter_trigger kind.
features._design: 10 x-cards with values (1000,100,50,50,20,20,10,10,5,5) + 2 y-cards (both ×2); each round: (1) roll count_x in [1,5] by x_count_weights, (2) roll count_y in [0,2] by y_count_weights, (3) weighted-draw count_x x-cards WITHOUT replacement by x_value_weights, (4) weighted-draw count_y y-cards by y_value_weights, (5) R = sum(x_drawn) × product(y_drawn). Test strategy: auto-accept when R ≥ 40; else reroll. 3 reroll + 1 forced accept = 4 rounds max.
